Select approved drugs with mechanism action_type 'BLOCKER'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and target_dictionary. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
